summary: The Maldives is a tropical island paradise renowned for crystal-clear turquoise waters, pristine white sand beaches, and exceptional coral reefs. This luxurious destination offers world-class diving and snorkeling, unique overwater resort experiences, and romantic island escapes with consistently warm weather year-round.

photography.goldenHourNotes: The Maldives enjoys consistent equatorial light with two distinct golden hours lasting approximately 45-60 minutes each. Early morning golden hour between 6-7 AM is optimal for reflecting light off calm lagoon waters and silhouetting palm trees, while evening golden hour from 6-7 PM provides warm side-lighting on reef formations and traditional boats. Underwater golden hour photography is best achieved during morning dives when light rays penetrate crystalline water with maximum color saturation.

weather.seasonality: The Maldives has two distinct seasons: the dry northeast monsoon (November-March) offers calm waters and sunny skies ideal for water activities, while the wet southwest monsoon (May-September) brings increased rainfall and rougher seas but with fewer tourists and excellent diving opportunities. April and October are transitional months with unpredictable weather patterns.
weather.summary: The Maldives maintains consistently warm tropical temperatures between 28-30°C year-round with warm ocean waters averaging 26-27°C. The dry season from November to March is the peak tourist season with minimal rainfall and excellent visibility for both water activities and photography.
